Tarun Agarwal
Senior Accountant | Pune, Maharashtra
tarun.agarwal826@example.com | +91 9531056824

Experienced accounting professional with strong operational and compliance focus across corporate and mid-market environments. Proven track record in managing statutory filings, vendor payments, reconciliations and ERP integrations to improve accuracy and cycle times. Comfortable working with cross-functional teams to implement process controls and month-end close procedures.

Experience

Senior Accountant — Onsite
- Managed TDS compliance for 120+ vendor contracts, reducing late payment penalties by 40% through proactive quarterly reconciliations using SAP FICO and Tally ERP 9.
- Streamlined Accounts Payable processes, cutting vendor invoice processing time from 12 days to 6 days by implementing a standardized approval matrix and Jira-based issue tracking.
- Led SAP FICO month-end activities, reconciling GL accounts and resolving 350+ discrepancies, improving close accuracy and reducing post-close adjustments by 30%.

Ledgerly, Nov 2021 - Jan 2024
Accountant — Hybrid
- Handled end-to-end Accounts Payable for a 200+ vendor base, negotiating payment terms that improved cash flow and decreased outstanding payable days by 18%; maintained records in Tally ERP 9.
- Managed GST returns and reconciliations across multiple GSTINs, identifying and correcting filing discrepancies worth INR 1.2M.
- Produced complex reports in Microsoft Excel, including pivot-based aging analyses and variance reports that supported monthly management reviews.

Medisure, Mar 2017 - Oct 2021
Accounts Manager — Onsite
- Oversaw Accounts Payable and TDS processes for a portfolio of regional offices, ensuring timely TDS deposits and reducing TDS filing errors to under 1% annually.
- Implemented Tally ERP 9 for centralized transaction recording across five branches, improving ledger consistency and cutting reconciliation time by 35%.
- Coordinated GST compliance and monthly reconciliations, leading a team that closed monthly books within 7 business days consistently.

Projects
- Vendor Payment Optimization (Capgemini): Designed a vendor prioritization model in Excel and tracked exceptions in Jira to reduce critical vendor payment delays by 50% in three months.
- GST Reconciliation Toolkit (Ledgerly): Built Excel templates and macros to automate matching of GSTR-2A with book entries, reducing manual reconciliation time by 60%.
